topic: Pyroclastic Materials and Volcano Alert Levels
key_concepts: Ash particles are smaller than 2 mm.
Lapilli particles range from 2 mm to 64 mm.
Volcanic bombs are larger than 64 mm and rounded.
Volcanic blocks are larger than 64 mm and angular.
Pyroclastic materials can be identified by size, texture, color, and other distinguishing
Volcano alert levels indicate associated volcanic hazards or materials.
Volcano alert levels are organized from Level 1 to Level 4.
Ground expansion, earthquakes, and increased emissions can signal a possible eruption.
